           TONGO-DIPTERIX ODORATA

         Seeds of Coumarouna-a tree in Guiana

        (TONGO - DIPTRIX ODORATA)


Useful in neuralgia; pertussis.



Head.--  Tearing pain in supra-orbital nerve, with heat and
        throbbing pain in head and epiphora. Confused, especially the occiput, with somnolence and a
        sort of intoxication. Trembling in right upper lid. Coryza; nose stopped, must breathe
        through mouth.



Extremities.--  Tearing pains in hip-joints, femur, and knee,
        especially left side.



Relationship.--    Melilotus.
        Anthoxanthum, Asperula  , and   Tonga   contain   Coumarin  , the active principle. Compare them in hay-fever;
        also,   Trifol; Napth; Sabad  .



Dose.--  Tincture and lower potencies.
